page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-2xL4 is an x86_64 architecture server running on the KVM hypervisor. The system is configured with 32 shared vCPUs and 384.0 GB of system memory, which provides a resource density of 12.0 GB of RAM per core. Graphics and parallel processing acceleration are delivered by two NVIDIA L4 GPUs based on the Ada Lovelace architecture, offering a combined total of 48 GB of VRAM.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning that block storage must be provisioned and attached separately for data persistence. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address. A primary hardware tradeoff is the shared CPU allocation, which may result in variable CPU performance under co-tenant load, though this is balanced by the dedicated dual-GPU hardware and large memory capacity.

The hardware profile makes this server suitable for GPU-accelerated and memory-intensive workloads. It is designed for tasks such as machine learning inference, data science processing, video rendering, and parallelized analytical computations that require substantial memory and GPU acceleration rather than dedicated, high-performance CPU cores.
